title: Frosted plaza flagstones
subject: Subject: the paving of an old city plaza in deep frost, about 3 m across, seen from above. Big squarish slate-blue and grey flagstones, some cracked, with white rime and crusted frost filling the joints and spreading in lacy patches over the stones, spread evenly. Cold blue-lavender colours, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The ground of the final fight on the dead Moonwell's court.

title: Moonwell wall carving: moth and crescents
subject: Subject: one stretch of the Moonwell's carved stone wall, seen flat from the front: a large moth with spread patterned wings carved in relief in the middle, a crescent moon carved on each side of it, on smooth old grey-blue stone with a moulded band along the top and the bottom. Frost in the carving's hollows. About 2.5 m long and 1.2 m high.
use: Repeated round the wall of the dead Moonwell in the final fight.

title: Ruined gothic tower
subject: Subject: one tall ruined gothic stone tower, seen flat from the front, about 35 m high: dark grey-blue stone, tall pointed lancet windows (dark, no light), slender pinnacles at its corners and a broken spire at the top, snow on its ledges.
use: The towers of Misthollow round the dead Moonwell, as far backdrop pieces or models.

title: Ruined arched bridge
subject: Subject: a stretch of a ruined stone bridge on tall slender pointed arches, seen flat from the side, about 40 m long: five or six arches, dark grey-blue stone, a broken parapet along the top, snow on the top and the ledges.
use: The arcades and bridges of Misthollow behind the dead Moonwell.

title: The moon going out
subject: Subject: the moon on the longest night, going out: a bright pale silver-white disc with soft lavender-grey seas and craters, but with a large round bite of dark night sky taken out of its upper right side, so it looks like a thick crescent. Painted in detail, filling most of the picture with a small margin, only a faint glow at its edge.
use: The moon over the final fight at the dead Moonwell.
